MnNSEReedArrivalText: REED: You got a partner for carrying a parcel?
I want a team that wins. And work that pays for it.
MnNSEReedAfterText: People remember the trainer who wins.
You can keep doing their errands. I will find a better offer.
MnArcRCWaitingText: REED: I asked about a contract. They sent me to this waiting room.
MnArcRCPathsText: REED: They trusted you with the originals.
I asked for the escort job. They said I needed experience.
An ICE recruiter in Minneapolis did not ask for references. They pay for a team.
MnArcRCChallengeText: Show me what they saw in you. Battle?
MnArcRCBeforeText: REED: No one is going to carry me.
MnArcRCWonText: A delivery does not make you better than me.
MnArcRCAfterText: REED: My interview is at the dispatch office.
When I have a proper team, we will do this again.
MnArcRCDeclinedText: REED: The nurse is right there. I can wait.
MnNICEReedQuestionText: REED: I came for the security interview.
And ELLIS? What did they do?
MnNICEReedAfterText: REED: You made me look useless in front of them.
LODE has a shipment at Union Depot. I am taking that escort.
You can take ELLIS home. Stay away from my next job.
MnNICEReedWonText: You had to do that in front of everyone.
MnArcSPBeforeText: REED: The crew and this load go north.
MINA: FINN needs that meter. He is not your cargo.
REED: He signed. Stay out of the aisle.
MnArcSPReadyText: REED: Get your team ready. I am not leaving without my load. Battle?
MnArcSPDeclinedText: MINA: Go to the clinic. I will keep him here.
MnArcSPWonText: REED: The northbound load left while you were here.
They can still use me at the mine.
MnArcSPAfterText: MINA: He did not take our copy. He cannot make us forget.
Let me tell you where FINN was sent.
MnArcSCBeforeText: REED: That worker left a contracted shift. I am taking them back.
SERA: The lift cage jammed. I went for help.
REED: I decide what goes in the report.
MnArcSCChoiceText: SERA has not agreed to go with him. Stand beside SERA?
MnArcSCDeclinedText: SERA: Please do not leave me alone with him.
MnNDrillReedWorkText: REED: I signed for this run. Keep the drive moving.
MnNDrillReedWonText: They saw that. There goes the promotion.
MnArcHarborIntakeText: WORKER: That is a locking cradle.
IVY: I found my crew at the intake. We cannot clear it while the drive runs.
Send the live readings. ELLIS will hold the line.
MnArcLinkReadyText: The chief cannot stop you using the receiver now.
Send the live readings to ELLIS and the intake crew?
MnArcLinkText: ELLIS: I have the readings. JO is beside me.
IVY: The intake is still live. REED has the local drive.
ELLIS: I can hold the public line. Go through the service hatch. We will stay with you.
MnArcLinkAfterText: ELLIS: The intake crew is waiting. The hatch is on your right.
MnArcFinalReadyText: REED is holding the local drive. Your team ready?
MnArcFinalDeclinedText: IVY: The medic is upstairs. We will hold here.
MnArcFinalAfterText: REED: Fine. Touch it. See who gets paid for this mess.
MnArcFinalLockedText: REED: The chief is at the receiver. This floor is closed.
MnArcIntakeSeenText: The drive hammers. A pale shape pulls against the intake bars.
IVY: KETTLURK is caught in its own current. Shut the drive before we open the gate.
MnArcIntakeReadyText: Stop the drive and release the intake gate?
MnArcIntakeDeniedText: REED is still guarding the local drive.
MnArcIntakeOpenText: The drive stops. The intake gate lifts.
IVY: Clear the channel. Give it room.
MnArcIntakeEscapeText: KETTLURK folds into the returning water. The cage is empty.
IVY: The pull has eased. The crew can cross.
MnArcIntakeCrewText: FINN: The last crew is clear. NELL knows we are out.
ELLIS: I have the pump crews. North line off. South line off.
JO: Tell them they can come home.
MnArcIntakeReedExitText: IVY: Leave the badge here. You cannot use it on anyone else.
REED: It was their badge. They can come and collect it.
MnArcIntakeDoneText: The current settles. The lakes are no longer feeding the pumps.
ELLIS: The readings are public. We will keep the line open.
MnArcIntakeAfterText: IVY: The cage stays open. We are removing the winch next.
MnArcIntakeIvyText: IVY: I came to find my crew. They sent us to build this.
MnArcIntakeFinnText: FINN: The repaired meter matches ELLIS now.
This time we get to stop when the gauge says stop.
MnArcAftermathText: REED: They kept the last pay. Said the equipment was my responsibility.
I wanted a team that made people listen.
Now every station knows my name.
Do not ask me to thank you.
MnArcSeraWaitingText: SERA: I left the lift to find help. REED followed me here.
MnArcTamarackAfterText: TAMARACK: The river eggs are back in warm nests.
One journey did not fix every bank. It gave us time to care for them.
MnArcEllisAfterText: ELLIS: The crew calls come here now. No one has to ask ICE for a line.
JO kept the kettle on through the last shutdown call.
We will do the work of putting this right.
MnArcJoAfterText: The light stays on for the crews coming home.
MnArcMinaAfterText: MINA: FINN called from the intake. They let the last crew out.
You can sit down this time. I will carry the next message.
MnArcNellAfterText: NELL: FINN is coming home after the intake shift.
We are not going to talk about work tonight.
MnArcHabitatText: The GILLPUP huddles away from the dry channel.
IVY: The test pulled the water out from under its nest.
My crew went to check the gauge. They have not called back.
MnArcHabitatAfterText: IVY: The water is holding now. That GILLPUP went back to its nest.
MnArcSPBattleText: REED: Move MINA away from the load.

scene_contracts.purpose: Competition over trust and status; Reed wants a paid training contract.
scene_contracts.consequence: Player earns the delivery responsibility Reed wanted.

scene_contracts.purpose: Reed names the Minneapolis interview before traveling there. Ivy tends displaced Gillpup and worries about her missing crew.
scene_contracts.consequence: Refusal preserves the challenge; defeat never grants victory. The interview remains his destination.

scene_contracts.purpose: The appointment becomes recruitment. Reed knowingly identifies Ellis to ICE.
scene_contracts.consequence: Ellis is held in the headquarters; the player must reach the relay and physically free them.

scene_contracts.purpose: Reed defends the institution that gave him authority.
scene_contracts.consequence: Power shutdown and Ellis release are separate actions. Reed leaves for the St Paul transfer.

scene_contracts.purpose: Mina confronts Reed about Finn and the northbound crew.
scene_contracts.consequence: Victory does not accept Mina's request; the player must acknowledge that separately.

scene_contracts.purpose: The player interrupts Sera's forced transfer before the fifth badge.
scene_contracts.consequence: Sera visibly leaves custody; Reed withdraws without apologizing. Refusal leaves the scene retryable.

scene_contracts.purpose: Reed knowingly guards the endangered lift crew in exchange for promotion.
scene_contracts.consequence: Independent haulage, ventilation, feed and drive operations lead to Finn and Nell's rescue.

scene_contracts.purpose: A physical locking cradle and Ivy's live radio call connect the mine machinery to Kettlurk's confinement.
scene_contracts.consequence: The crew awaits shutdown at the Boundary intake; evidence alone cannot release them.

scene_contracts.purpose: The chief falls and Ellis establishes a live radio link.
scene_contracts.consequence: The hatch opens only after acknowledgment; neither the chief battle nor the link restores the survey.

scene_contracts.purpose: The player sees Kettlurk and the trapped crew, defeats Reed, and separately operates the local drive.
scene_contracts.consequence: The gate opens; Kettlurk visibly reaches water; Ivy and Finn move clear. Reed loses authority. Restoration waits for all acknowledgments.

scene_contracts.purpose: Tamarack, Ellis, Jo, Mina and Nell react to the changed region.
scene_contracts.consequence: Optional Reed encounter at St Cloud station is unrepentant; League member Halden and route trainers retain separate identities.

acceptance_contracts: Only active Minnesota species in Minnesota appearances; legal native moves and evolution levels.
No victory, release or restoration flags on refusal or loss.
Continue restores actor visibility, local gate state and completed crew movements.
No new paper-fetch gates; preserve the existing authored lairs and routes.
Ordinary-party campaign evidence must be earned through production controller input and kept separate from chapter fixtures.

grunts.seen: Open your bag. We decide what counts as evidence.
The passenger list travels with the ore.
I sent the van. I knew who was inside.
A closed office is still our office.
A complaint is a name and an address. Useful things.
I keep their vans running. They keep me paid.
No calls. No visitors. Keep walking.
You are not getting a signal out.
The notices went up after we started. That is your warning.
The runoff goes downhill. So do the complaints.
Every loaded truck has a bonus on it. Move.
There is no stop code on my orders.
The gauges are red. The pumps stay on.
Nobody measures the water until we finish.
That water was clear when we got here. So what?
They can drink bottled water. We have a deadline.
The crew asked for air. Management asked for output.
My shift ends when that vein is empty.
We heard them calling from the lower shaft.
The boss said to keep people away. That includes the crew.
No names. No report. You came here alone.
The water leaves. The minerals stay. That is the contract.
We took the people who could identify the site.
They promised protection. We promised production.
